arguments.value: Harry Sandlin Mattice Jr. was born in 1954 in Chattanooga, Tennessee. He earned a B.S. from the University of Tennessee in 1976 and a J.D. from the University of Tennessee College of Law in 1981. He practiced privately in Tennessee from 1981 to 2001, served as senior counsel to the U.S. Senate Committee on Governmental Affairs in 1997, and was U.S. attorney for the Eastern District of Tennessee from 2001 to 2005. He served as a judge of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Tennessee from 2005 until his retirement in 2021.
